recent.title: Regular Session
recent.text: Thank you, Mr. President. And thank you, Majority Leader Andrea Stewart-Cousins. Like always, you just so eloquently said all the things. But if I were to add anything, you know, I have the privilege of serving the 30th District, which includes the Village of Harlem. And that was the home to Hazel Dukes. She was bigger than Harlem. She's worldwide. But, you know, I always looked at her that she…
